_note: Simulated lift tests: two 6-week geo tests, paid social raised by 50% in test regions and influencer cut by 50%. Each result is the true lift plus realistic measurement error (standard error about a quarter of the lift), made by scripts/make_lift_tests.py with seed 2026; the true lifts are in truth/lift_tests_truth.json, which the model never reads. Spend is weekly USD at total-business scale; lift_per_week is the measured change in the target per week (negative for a cut), sd its standard error.
